description: Input fixture for the narrative stage eval: a locked brief + approved 9-slide skeleton. deck-narrative must return one complete SLIDE BRIEF per skeleton slide.

brief.context: the brand data-platform modernization pitch to Nordwind Retail GmbH (fictional); delivery lead presenting; €1.5M engagement
anti_references: not a wall of identical cards

skeleton.message: Cover — Nordwind data platform: from nightly batch to same-hour insight
The nightly batch window caps every downstream decision at T+1
A lakehouse platform removes the batch ceiling without a big-bang migration
Target architecture: ingest, lakehouse core, self-service consumption
Proof: the order-tracking pilot cut refresh latency from 14h to 20min
Every delivery risk has a named owner and a running mitigation
Phased delivery: pilot, scale-out, run — value in each phase
Closing — the two decisions we need from this committee
